title: Secret Number · Together
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Secret Number · Together with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: The lead writes a whole number from 1 to 10 without showing it. The others make up to four guesses; after each, the lead says higher, lower or correct. The group guesses the number within four guesses. Play eight turns in total, rotating the lead. The group wins together if at least five turns succeed.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: Paper and pencil.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Secret Number, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group guesses the number within four guesses.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The group guesses the number within four guesses.
